name: Ananya Sharma
review: DoConnect helped me find the perfect plan for my elderly parents. The comparison table was incredibly detailed, and their advisor assisted me via WhatsApp. Cashless approval took only 2 hours!

name: Rajesh Malhotra
review: I upgraded our basic insurance to a Super Top-Up plan of 20 Lakhs. The price difference between companies was clear, and the WhatsApp redirect allowed me to ask specific queries immediately.

name: Vikram Adityan
review: The website is beautifully designed! Super fast transitions, and the comparison dashboard works perfectly. It does not force you to sign up or input passwords. Very high quality UX.

name: Priyanka Sen
review: I saved over ₹6,000 on my family floater plan using their suggestions. The website explained the waiting period clearly. Very direct, clean information without annoying sales calls.

name: Amit Deshmukh
review: My claims experience was painless because I followed the detailed timeline on DoConnect. I immediately informed the insurer through the WhatsApp shortcut and got cashless approval.
